steps.title: Interaction Decision service: port fuseTurnCompletion into a real, callable service
steps.task: Create services/interaction-decision-service.js exporting computeTurnCompletionConfidence(turns, options), a deterministic port of fuseTurnCompletion from scripts/prototype-conversational-contracts-v1.mjs (39/39-proven scoring: +25 finalTranscript, +35/-15 trailing punctuation, +15/-35 trailing filler word, up to +30 scaled by pauseMs vs minimumPauseMs (default 600), +5 if previous turn was assistant; score clamped 0-100; finished = score >= threshold (default 90)). No AI/model call anywhere in this file.
steps.spec: Two parameters: computeTurnCompletionConfidence(turns, options = {}). turns is an array of {role, text, ts} objects. Read options BEFORE reading any turn: const { currentIndex = turns.length - 1, pauseMs = 0, finalTranscript = true, minimumPauseMs = 600, threshold = 90 } = options || {}. Then select the current turn SAFELY -- never call .trim() or any string method without a null/undefined guard first: const current = turns[currentIndex]; const text = String(current && current.text ? current.text : '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); Scoring, starting from score = 0: if (finalTranscript) score += 25; if (/[.!?\u2026]\s*$/.test(text)) score += 35; else score -= 15; if (/\b(um|uh|like|you know)[.!?\u2026]?\s*$/i.test(text)) score -= 35; else score += 15; if (pauseMs >= minimumPauseMs) score += 30; else if (pauseMs > 0) score += Math.round((pauseMs / minimumPauseMs) * 30); if (currentIndex > 0 && turns[currentIndex - 1] && turns[currentIndex - 1].role === 'assistant') score += 5; score = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, score)); Return { finished: score >= threshold, confidence: score, pause_ms: pauseMs, sources: [...] } where sources is an array of { source, value, weight } entries recording each factor above (this exact algorithm is fuseTurnCompletion in scripts/prototype-conversational-contracts-v1.mjs -- read that file to confirm, but the arithmetic above is authoritative and must be followed exactly, including the safe-access guard on `current`). Pure function, no I/O, no network call, no AI/model call. Add a @ssot docs/products/lifeos/PRODUCT_HOME.md JSDoc tag at the top of the file per repo convention.
